name: Kelly's Home Centre
brand_truth: Since 1927, everything for the Bahamian home under one roof at Marathon, delivered to every island.

design.signature: Drifting wall of their real department photos; mail boat instruction builder; life-moments selector

current_site_findings: Homepage leads with seasonal banners; 'since 1927' and 'Nassau's largest department store' are only on the About page.
Store hours are published as a 2025 image that Google and screen readers cannot read.
The Family Island mail boat instructions are three images with no text.
An April 2025 flyer is still loaded on every page.
Gift registry, Contractor Cards and in-store pick up are scattered across links and outside sites.
pitch_line: Your Family Island customers are your most loyal and your mail boat instructions are just three pictures; this concept turns them into a two-minute form and puts 'since 1927' back on the front door.
assumptions: Store hours omitted (only published as an image)
Contractor Cards mentioned by name only
Island list in the mail boat helper taken from their newsletter form
notes: Record said no site, but kellysbahamas.com is a working e-commerce site (BuilderWire): pitch is a front-end and UX repositioning, not a new store. Trading name is Kelly's House & Home.
